purpose: Replace the GitHub Action's regex-on-tag-string guess for GitHub Release pre-release status with a real, parsed boolean carried on ReleaseEntry, so `--prerelease` is passed to `gh release create` based on the actual SemVer/PEP 440 pre-release status of the release's resolved Version, not on whether the rendered tag string happens to contain one of a fixed set of substrings.
scope: 1. Add a new required boolean field to `ReleaseEntry` in crates/callisto-model/src/plan.rs. 2. Populate that field at the one construction site of ReleaseEntry in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (plan_publish, inside the `releases.push(ReleaseEntry { ... })` block, currently lines 505-510), computed from the owned `ver: Version` value already bound at line 237 and in scope at that call site, via its existing `is_prerelease()` method. 3. Update every other ReleaseEntry struct literal in the workspace (callisto-cli/src/commands/publish.rs:357; callisto-graph/tests/tag_sha_fabrication_test.rs:98; callisto-graph/tests/tags_tests.rs:23,111,273,404,410) to set `is_prerelease` explicitly. 4. Update crates/callisto-cli/tests/schema_guard_test.rs's ReleaseEntry assertions and its module-doc permitted-schema-delta allowlist. 5. Update .github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml's GitHub Release creation loop (currently lines 200-216) to iterate release entries (not tag strings) and read `isPrerelease` off each entry directly, hard-failing if the field is absent, null, or non-boolean rather than defaulting to false. 6. Add a new test to .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/ following the extraction-and-stub pattern established in test_status_check_branching.sh, proving the new loop's behavior for a SemVer fixture, a PEP 440 regression fixture, a false case, a missing-key case, and a non-boolean-value case. 7. Update docs/01-spec.md's ReleaseEntry field documentation (struct doc block at lines 1740-1763) and append a new decision-table row after row 23 (currently line 2667) documenting the new field, without modifying row 23 itself.
non_goals: No `schemaVersion` bump on PublishPlan/ReleaseEntry's JSON schema -- this is an additive field, consistent with this session's established precedent (StatusReport's hasChangesets/lastReleasedVersion/releaseTrigger additions shipped with no schemaVersion bump). This includes the schema_guard_test.rs baseline update in scope item 4: growing ReleaseEntry's required-key set is an intentional, allowlisted delta, not a schema-contract violation requiring a version bump.

`ver` is an owned `callisto_model::Version`, bound at crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs:237 from either `bump.to` or the current manifest version, and already in scope at the `releases.push(ReleaseEntry { ... })` block at line 505; no new parameter or return type is introduced to plan_publish.
No change to Version::is_prerelease()'s SemVer/PEP 440 parsing logic itself (crates/callisto-model/src/version.rs:126-131) -- it is reused as-is, not modified or re-implemented.

No fallback regex path retained in action.yml for any reason (e.g. absent field, older plan JSON) -- the regex-based `[[ "$TAG" =~ -(alpha|beta|rc|pre|next) ]]` branch is removed entirely, not kept as a secondary check, since the Action always invokes a freshly-built `callisto plan-publish --format json` in the same run and there is no cross-version JSON compatibility boundary to bridge. A missing, null, or non-boolean `isPrerelease` value is a hard error (AC-015), never a silent false.
No changes to NpmMainPublish, NpmPublish, PypiPublish, or any other PublishPlan entry type -- only ReleaseEntry gains this field.

No reconciliation of the pre-existing, unrelated drift where docs/01-spec.md's ReleaseEntry doc block (lines 1740-1763) omits the `package`/`PackageId` field that the live struct (crates/callisto-model/src/plan.rs:111-118) already has -- that gap predates this change and is out of scope here; only the new field is added to the doc.

No update to README.md or ARCHITECTURE.md -- neither file documents ReleaseEntry's field shape or the Action's --prerelease behavior today (confirmed by grep), so neither requires a change under this spec.
No change to how `gh release create`'s other flags (`--title`, `--generate-notes`) are derived -- only the `--prerelease` flag's derivation changes.

This spec's edit to the `releases.push(ReleaseEntry { ... })` block in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (lines 505-510) touches the same struct literal that SPEC-TRACK4-RELEASE-PIPELINE-CONTRACT-CORRECTNESS's AC-10/AC-10b/AC-11/AC-12 already modified (populating `changelog_section`) earlier in this session -- that spec is already implemented and committed, so this spec's diff is against the post-TRACK4 state of that block (which already includes `changelog_section`), not the pre-TRACK4 hardcoded-`None` state. No field ordering within the literal is prescribed beyond `is_prerelease` being present as a keyed field.

No change to the pre-existing `if ver.is_prerelease()` npm dist-tag branch at crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs:390 -- that call site is unrelated to this spec and predates it; AC-013's prohibition on new conditional branches applies only to the NEW call site added at line 505, not to this existing one.

api_surface.name: ReleaseEntry.is_prerelease
api_surface.signature: pub is_prerelease: bool  // in crates/callisto-model/src/plan.rs, struct ReleaseEntry (currently lines 111-118), under #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] and #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] -> JSON key "isPrerelease"
api_surface.description: New required (non-Option, no skip_serializing_if) boolean field on ReleaseEntry. Always present in every serialized ReleaseEntry, including PublishPlan.releases[] JSON emitted by `callisto plan-publish --format json`.

api_surface.name: Version::is_prerelease
api_surface.signature: pub fn is_prerelease(&self) -> bool  // crates/callisto-model/src/version.rs:126-131 (unchanged; reused, not modified)
api_surface.description: Existing method on callisto_model::Version, already correct for both grammars: for SemVer, true iff `!v.pre.is_empty()`; for PEP 440, true iff `!v.is_post() && (v.is_pre() || v.is_dev())`. This is the single source of truth ReleaseEntry.is_prerelease must be derived from at construction time -- never re-derived from a tag string.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: crates/callisto-model/src/plan.rs's ReleaseEntry struct has a new field `is_prerelease: bool` with no `Option` wrapper and no `#[serde(skip_serializing_if = ...)]` attribute, so the field appears in every serialized ReleaseEntry's JSON output as the key "isPrerelease" (per the struct's existing `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`), never omitted.

Running `callisto plan-publish --format json` in a workspace with at least one publishable package produces a PublishPlan JSON whose `releases[]` entries each contain an `isPrerelease` boolean key (in addition to the existing `tagName`, `sha`, and optional `changelogSection` keys).

For a package P whose resolved release version is the SemVer value `1.2.3` (no pre-release component), the entry in `callisto plan-publish --format json`'s `releases[]` array whose `package` field equals P's PackageId -- there is exactly one such entry per package per invocation -- has `isPrerelease: false`.

Regression fixture (SemVer): for a package P whose resolved release version is the SemVer value `1.0.0-1` (a valid SemVer pre-release with a purely numeric identifier, containing none of the substrings "alpha", "beta", "rc", "pre", or "next" anywhere in its rendered tag string), the entry in `callisto plan-publish --format json`'s `releases[]` array whose `package` field equals P's PackageId has `isPrerelease: true`.

Regression fixture (PEP 440, the original bug this spec exists to fix): for a package P whose resolved release version is the PEP 440 value `1.2.3a1` (a canonical PEP 440 pre-release with no dash and no substring match against "alpha", "beta", "rc", "pre", or "next" anywhere in its rendered tag string, e.g. tag `v1.2.3a1`), the entry in `callisto plan-publish --format json`'s `releases[]` array whose `package` field equals P's PackageId has `isPrerelease: true`.

For a package P whose resolved release version is the PEP 440 value `1.0.0.dev1` (a dev-release, which the codebase's existing `Version::is_prerelease()` test `pep440_dev_release_is_prerelease` at crates/callisto-model/src/version.rs:365 already asserts must be treated as pre-release), the entry in `callisto plan-publish --format json`'s `releases[]` array whose `package` field equals P's PackageId has `isPrerelease: true`, proving the field is computed via `Version::is_prerelease()` end-to-end through plan_publish rather than a narrower ad hoc check that only recognizes alpha/beta/rc.

ReleaseEntry.is_prerelease is computed at its one construction site in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (the `releases.push(ReleaseEntry { ... })` block) directly from the owned `ver: Version` value bound at line 237 and already in scope there, by calling `ver.is_prerelease()` -- confirmable by inspecting that no new call to `Version::parse`, no string parsing of `tag_name`, and no regex against the tag string appears anywhere in that construction path.

.github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml's GitHub Release creation loop (the `::group::5. Creating GitHub Release Entries` block) no longer contains the pattern `=~ -(alpha|beta|rc|pre|next)` anywhere in its script body.

The loop iterates release *entries*, not tag strings -- e.g. `jq -c '.releases[]?'` -- and for each entry reads `tagName` and `isPrerelease` off that same entry object, so no cross-entry lookup by tag is performed. `gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --generate-notes` is invoked with the additional flag `--prerelease` if and only if that same entry's `isPrerelease` is `true`; when it is `false`, the same invocation runs with no `--prerelease` flag. Two entries rendering an identical tag string are processed independently, each on its own entry's `isPrerelease` value.

A new test file under .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/ (either a new script or an extension of test_status_check_branching.sh) follows the same established harness pattern -- it extracts the exact current run-body text of the `::group::5. Creating GitHub Release Entries` block directly out of action.yml via a `sed` range between its `::group::` and matching `::endgroup::` markers, stubs `gh` (and `jq` remains real) to capture invocation arguments, feeds it a fixture `$PLAN_JSON` value, and asserts on the captured `gh release create` argument list -- so the test cannot drift from action.yml's actual current logic. This test includes at minimum: one case with `isPrerelease: true` where the tag string contains no alpha/beta/rc/pre/next substring (the AC-005 PEP 440 regression fixture), one case with `isPrerelease: false`, one case covering AC-015's missing-key path, and one case covering AC-015's non-boolean-value path.

docs/01-spec.md's ReleaseEntry struct documentation block (the section spanning the struct doc comments immediately preceding `pub struct ReleaseEntry` at line 1742) is updated to list the new `is_prerelease` / `isPrerelease` field alongside the existing documented fields, stating that it is a required (non-optional) boolean. Separately, a new decision-table row is appended after row 23 (currently at line 2667), numbered 24, referencing §M.12.2, reading: `ReleaseEntry.is_prerelease` is a required `bool`, computed at plan time from the resolved `Version::is_prerelease()`, never re-derived from the rendered tag string. A grep of crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs's plan_publish function shows no default-false fallback, no `Result`/`Option` wrapping, and no new conditional branch introduced around the `ver.is_prerelease()` call added at the ReleaseEntry construction site (line 505) -- consistent with the owned `ver: Version` at that call site already being a successfully-parsed, non-optional value, so no malformed-version error path is reachable or needed at this construction site. ReleaseEntry's `is_prerelease` field computation introduces no new dependency edge from callisto-model to any AGPL-licensed crate: `Version::is_prerelease()` is defined and remains defined in crates/callisto-model/src/version.rs, a crate whose Cargo.toml declares `license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"` and whose `[dependencies]` list (semver, pep440_rs, serde, serde_json, thiserror, miette, camino, path-slash, schemars, tempfile) contains no AGPL crate; `cargo metadata`'s resolve graph for callisto-model shows no edge to any crate licensed AGPL after this change.

For a release entry processed by .github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml's GitHub Release creation loop whose `isPrerelease` key is absent, `null`, or of any JSON type other than boolean (e.g. a stale cached plan, a hand-edited fixture, or a plan produced by a pre-this-change callisto binary), the step fails with a non-zero exit code and an error message naming the offending tag, before any `gh release create` call is made for that entry -- it is never silently treated as `isPrerelease: false`. Presence and type are tested explicitly (e.g. `jq -e 'has("isPrerelease") and (.isPrerelease|type=="boolean")'`); the `//` alternative operator must not be used to read this field, since `false // empty` yields empty and would make a legitimate `false` indistinguishable from a missing key.
